frozen_before_the_run.recipes: unchanged from the 7 November run (YOLO11s detect and YOLO11s-seg, 40 epochs, 640 px, batch 16; ResNet-50 fine-tune 10 epochs, lr 1e-4)

frozen_before_the_run.a9b: bound 0.001, 4 random inputs, seed 0, CPU, unchanged

44.sessions: classifier and detector in the session of 13 Nov 02:59 UTC; that Colab runtime was lost during segmenter training; segmenter retrained from the start (same seed, recipe, data) in the session of 13 Nov 06:54 UTC

gpu_hours.note: two sessions lost their Colab runtime; each is counted at its wall-clock upper bound (3.4 h and 2.95 h); completed work: 1.556 h, 2.774 h and 1.522 h

caveats: the v2 test split had already been evaluated once on 7 November (seed 42, no W&B); recipes, thresholds and rules were not changed after that look

the seed-42 segmenter metrics equal the 7 November values to the last recorded digit (same seed and segmentation labels); deterministic training is the likely reason and was not verified independently
the W&B run ids of the seed-42 detector and of the seed-44 classifier and detector are not in the records (the lookup at resume returned nothing); the runs exist in the W&B group
v1 and v2 test sets are not the same images (1,106 vs 1,050)
A9b is met by one of the three detector exports and not by the other two, with identical final detections in all three; it is not a selection criterion
